column5: a UserPromptSubmit whose prompt head carries a making verb in an imperative clause and names a proper noun, a quoted term, or a digit-letter token outside code spans; appends to the session ledger and states the gate shape once per prompt that added entries; silent on questions, slash commands, and under CC_ASK_LEDGER=off

a Stop whose session ledger has entries and whose final assistant message has no line naming an entry with as named, substituted, omitted or pending; sends the turn back (JSON block) with the missing names, at most twice per ask (the count resets when the ledger clears or the gate gives up); silent with no ledger, while the payload's background_tasks lists a subagent, a teammate or a running shell naming a check, and under CC_ASK_LEDGER=off
